snippet.title: Cozyrama - out now on Steam!
snippet.description:
Cozyrama is a peaceful sandbox where you shape your own magical dioramas. Sculpt it, pick the right colors, decorate with hundreds of items and add cute animals. Observe a cozy world grow around you! No pressure or timers. Just relax, unwind, and let your imagination bloom! Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3133020/Cozyrama/

Join our Discord to share your dioramas and meet other cozy enthusiasts:  https://discord.gg/t9rWYDjsBM

Social media channels:
Tiktok: https://www.tiktok.com/@cozyrama
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cozyramagame
X: https://x.com/Cozyrama
Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/cozyrama.bsky.social
